description: Files written by a generator from the catalog/OpenAPI/registries. A feature PR changes the source (providers.ts, openapi.yaml, the skill catalog, the free-tier catalog); the generated copy is rewritten once by the release refresh (release:refresh-derived) or a nightly refresh PR, so sibling PRs stop conflicting on it. A PR that changes only a generator and its output (the companions below) is still allowed. Plan 2026-11-13, phase 5.

categories.why: Generated from src/shared/constants/providers.ts (whole catalog + totals + version/date header): every provider PR rewrote it, 30 of 321 open PRs on 2026-11-13.

Generated by scripts/docs/gen-readme-*.mjs (README_DIAGRAMS in gen-readme-diagrams.mjs) from live catalogs and counts; 26-28 open PRs rewrote the hero, comparison, pillars and terminal cards. Hand-drawn SVGs (pool-fair-share, combo-always-on, public/images/tier-flow-*) and the Mermaid exports are not in this list.
skills/<id>/references/endpoints.md is written entirely by src/lib/agentSkills/generator.ts from docs/openapi.yaml.

SKILL.md files with no hand-written custom block: the generator writes every byte. SKILL.md files that carry a <!-- skill:custom-start --> block are hand-edited too and stay out of this list (tests/unit/derived-paths-generated-family.test.ts keeps the list exact).
